changelog.notes: Legacy trial exported from CSPro survey (Harvard Dataverse, doi:10.7910/DVN/R57LRD) records into release schema v2.0.

study.title: Video-based product concept testing of cassava, Caribbean region of Colombia, 2024
study.description: Cassava farmers watched standardised one-minute videos presenting three of seven product concepts co-developed by CIAT and CIRAD, assigned at random (incomplete block design adapted from tricot), named the concept they liked most and least, and said which concept they would plant and on what area. 398 farmers in the departments of Bolívar, Córdoba and Sucre, November and December 2024 (survey NV_YUCA_2024). Taborda Andrade LA, Andrade Lopez RS, Tran TVK, Fenstemaker S, de Sousa K, Newby JC (2026). From Farmers to Breeders. Integrating video-based concept testing and data-driven text analysis to inform cassava breeding decisions. Harvard Dataverse, V1. https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/R57LRD
study.objective: market segmentation and product profile design

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point. Sites without coordinates take the mean of other sites in the same adm3 before rounding.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept, with spacing and capitalisation standardised

data_producer.name: International Center for Tropical Agriculture (CIAT)
data_producer.partner: Centre de coopération internationale en recherche agronomique pour le développement (CIRAD)

genotypes.postharvest_deterioration: up to 8 days without significant losses from deterioration

genotypes.harvest_time: up to 2 months earlier than other industrial varieties
